VETERANS AFFAIRS COMMISSION MINUTES
  WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 12, 2025
  2525 GRAND AVENUE, LONG BEACH, 90815
  ROOM 204, 5:00 PM

Juanita Doplemore, Chair  James Goodin, Commissioner
Kenneth Osborn, Vice Chair  James Schotter, Commissioner
Antawnette Atkins Blade, Commissioner  Nicholas Sramek, Commissioner

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

Chair Osborn called the meeting to order at 5:09 p.m.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Doplemore, Osborn, Atkins Blade, Goodin, Schotter, Sramek

Also present: Heather Van Wijk, Special Projects Officer, Anita Lakhani, Deputy City Attorney,
Gina Overholt, Coordinator.

Also in attendance: Christina Boatwright, Hershell Hardimon, Steven Hageman, and Alexandria O’
Bard.

 Staff report: Staff liaison (Overholt) reminded the Commissioners to complete their Form 700
(Statements of Economic Interests) through the LEARN system. They have received reminders as
well from City Clerk’s office. Discussion followed. The deadline is April 1. Staff also reported that the
Office of Veteran Support receives on average two calls per week with various inquiries from
Veterans or their families, most having to do with VA health care or benefits.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Commissioner Schotter led the Pledge of Allegiance.

  meeting of Wednesday, January 08, 2025.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Doplemore, seconded by
  Commissioner Sramek, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by
  the following vote:

2.  25-54328  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on a Veterans and Service
  Members Job Fair on April 17.

  Long Beach Public Service Corps Fellow Alexandria O’ Bard reported on the April
  17 Veteran and Service Member Job Fair, a collaboration between the Office of
  Veterans Support (Health Department) and the Economic Development
  Department. The two departments met for a walk-through of the event location to
  discuss logistics and roles and responsibilities. The team is working on the vendor
  invite, attendee invite, and promotional components including the media release,
  flyer and social graphics and seeking an event sponsor. The Commission
  discussed the event and agreed to support it by helping to identify potential
  sponsors and to promote it.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Doplemore, seconded by
  Commissioner Sramek, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by
  the following vote:

  Yes:  6  Goodin, Osborn, Doplemore, Sramek, Atkins Blade, Schotter
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

3.  25-54322  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the Veterans Banner
  Program.

  The estimate media release date is February 24, after which the banners program
  may be promoted extensively. Final preparation of the various components (website
  updates, social media, optional demographic data section of the nomination form, et
  al.) is underway. The deadline for banner nominations is March 31. Outreach to the
  Veterans community to promote the program will take the form of our participation
  in several regularly scheduled meetings at American Gold Star Manner, Long
  Beach City College, Century Villages at Cabrillo (five different meetings on three
  different dates in March), the VA Long Beach (two meetings), and First Friday in
  Bixby Knolls. The subcommittee is working on securing banner locations; Carson
  Street will remain a prime location for the 2025 program.
